description: Use this when the user wants a Thanksgiving cooking timeline, a holiday dinner cooking schedule or an oven schedule for several dishes. Convert the user's menu, pasted recipe notes or a photo of a menu into the dishes array (name, prep_minutes, cook_minutes, rest_minutes, method, oven_temp, make_ahead); use text only as a fallback. Works backward from serve_time (default Thanksgiving, 26 November 2026, 4:00 PM) and gives each step a clock time, detects oven conflicts (one oven by default, ovens: 2 for two), moves make-ahead dishes earlier, adds turkey roast and thaw steps from the USDA table when a turkey weight is given, and returns a printable checklist PDF, an ICS calendar file with a reminder per step, and a shopping-day note. Up to 25 dishes. Does not invent recipe times or give recipes.

cooks.description: People doing hands-on prep at the same time, default 1.

cook_minutes.description: Minutes on the heat (oven, stovetop or other), e.g. 45 or "1h 30m". 0 for no-cook dishes.

make_ahead.description: true if the dish can be cooked earlier and held or reheated (pies, casseroles, rolls). Only make-ahead dishes are moved earlier to make room in the oven.

method.description: oven, stovetop, no heat, or another appliance (microwave, slow cooker, grill, air fryer). Default: oven when oven_temp is given.

oven.description: Pin the dish to oven 1 or 2 (optional).

oven_temp.description: Oven temperature, e.g. 350, "375F", "180C" or "gas mark 4". °F unless temperature_unit is C.

prep_minutes.description: Hands-on prep minutes before cooking, e.g. 20 or "1 hour".

rest_minutes.description: Minutes between taking it off the heat and serving (rest, cool or chill), e.g. 10.

stuffed.description: Turkey only: true if stuffed. Default false.

weight.description: Turkey only: weight in lb or text such as "6 kg"; cook time then comes from the USDA table.

dishes.description: The menu as a list of dish objects. Convert the user's pasted menu, recipe notes or a photo of a menu into these fields. Example: [{"name":"Green bean casserole","prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":30,"oven_temp":350,"make_ahead":true},{"name":"Gravy","cook_minutes":15,"method":"stovetop"}]. Up to 25 dishes.

hold_minutes.description: Minutes a dish that is not make-ahead may come out early and wait covered to make room in the oven, default 30. 0 to never hold.

paper.description: PDF paper size: letter (default) or A4.

preheat_minutes.description: Minutes to preheat or change oven temperature, default 15.

reminder_minutes.description: Calendar alarm this many minutes before each step, default 5.

serve_date.description: Serve date if given separately, e.g. 2026-11-26.

serve_time.description: When dinner is served, e.g. "2026-11-26 16:00", "4:00 PM" or "Nov 26 5pm". Default date is Thanksgiving, 26 November 2026; default time 4:00 PM.

share_within_f.description: A dish that is not make-ahead may join an oven already running within this many °F (cooked about 10% longer per 25°F lower), default 25. 0 to keep recipe temperatures.

shopping_days_before.description: Shopping day this many days before serving, default 2.

temperature_unit.description: F (default) or C for oven temperatures given without a unit.

text.description: Fallback only: a pasted menu, one dish per line, e.g. "Stuffing: prep 20, bake 45 min at 350F, make ahead". Prefer dishes.

title.description: Title for the PDF and calendar, e.g. Thanksgiving at Grandma's.

frozen.description: true if the turkey is frozen now (adds a thaw step), false if fresh. Default: unknown, the thaw step says "if frozen".

prep_minutes.description: Prep minutes before it goes in (default 20).

rest_minutes.description: Minutes to rest before carving (default 30; USDA says at least 20).

stuffed.description: true if stuffed. Default false (USDA recommends cooking stuffing separately).

weight.description: Turkey weight in pounds, or text with a unit, e.g. 14 or "6.5 kg".

turkey.description: Optional turkey roasted from the USDA timetable at 325°F, e.g. {"weight":16,"stuffed":false,"frozen":true}.

name: plan_cooking_timeline
